cohort: The study included 977 low-risk pregnant women (483 non-Western, 494 Dutch) receiving midwife-led care.
finding: Non-Western women in a midwife-led care setting had increased odds of perineal laceration and decreased odds of high birthweight compared to Dutch women.
mod_finding: The mode of birth differed by ethnicity, with non-Western women in the prenatally referred group having decreased odds of cesarean section.
